Derby Stallion Gold.name: Derby Stallion Gold
Derby Stallion Gold.summary: A horse breeding and racing business management simulation game.

Funfair Party Games.name: Funfair Party Games
Funfair Party Games.summary: Multiplayer fun at the fair with movement control and eleven amazing attractions!

Mario & Luigi RPG - Paper Mario MIX.name: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam
Mario & Luigi RPG - Paper Mario MIX.summary: Paper Mario jumps out of a book and into the bizarre adventures of Mario & Luigi, resulting in hilarious, and dangerous, hijinks! Become the superstar team of Mario, Luigi and Paper Mario to take on quests, take down enemies, and untangle these two unique universes in this playful new entry in the Mario & Luigi series.

Medarot Dual - Kabuto Ver..summary: Medarot Dual is an arena-action spinoff of the Medabots series. Like most Medabots games, Dual is split into two separate versions.

World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014 - Aoki.name: World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014: Aoki Samurai no Chousen
World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014 - Aoki.summary: A Japan-exclusive port of Pro Evolution Soccer 2014. This version centers on career progression with the Japan national team, offering modes that guide players through international competition and national representation.
